derivation_rationale.summary: Six wind downforce design-pressure tests and one snow design test give a judgment prior (T4) on rack capacity over design (median 1.88, spread 0.47; unrounded 0.4767, 95% chi-square interval 0.307-1.050). The curve runs on compliant racks only with two mapping medians (1.32, 1.88); the 0.56 mapping is parked in an under-designed branch with no default share. Module breakage is split by mounting and conditional on rack survival. Glaze is a separate upper bound. No US calibration. Compound uncertainty is not propagated.
